notes.title: Pokémon adventure expansion preview
notes.text: Individual IV/EV/Nature/gender, a 2,222-item reference catalogue with implemented ball and medicine effects, reviewed shared stock import, Pokémon Center, four move slots with compatible level/TM/Tutor training, trainer teams, eight Kanto Gyms, rare quests and player-only Sandbox. Legacy profiles retain their stats. Actions follow chat/branch history. Simplified singles; abilities, weather, PvP and battle transformations are not simulated.
